summary: One procedure: a scribe with an order-2 stroke jig whose alphabet carries a word-end, a line-end and a paragraph mark (blended over eight tables, kept per part of the book and per hand), a tray of the last ten words which he lifts and alters with the same pen, a packet stocked once per 12-page quire and a chest kept per part of the book, and a line written to the margin -- he fills the ruled width and tries shorter forms when the room left is small. Fitted on the 192 public practice pages only. Practice evaluation: 19 of 22 established facts reproduced by the same text (seed 12 also 19, seed 13 18). It misses F-011, F-014 and F-020, all page-level. 4,487+738 lines, 0 four-word runs, 0 markers.
